[message_id=681773 author=BeyondBirthday first=True]
Hi NVIDIA Team,
Thank you for organizing this competition. While going through the competition details, I noticed an inconsistency in the Midpoint Cut-off Date between two sections:
In the Prizes section (Open Progress Prize): 
"Awarded to the team with the highest leaderboard score as of the Midpoint Cut-off Date: April 9, 2026."
In the Timeline section: 
"April 16, 2026 - Midpoint Cut-off Date"
Could you please confirm which date is the correct Midpoint Cut-off Date for the Open Progress Prize?
Thank you!

[message_id=3422316 author=Addison Howard first=False]
April 9 is correct - we moved the date up to ensure that a prospective winning team had a chance to provide documentation in advance of the announcement at Google Cloud NEXT.
I've updated the inconsistency

[message_id=3423264 author=BeyondBirthday first=False]
Thank you!
